title: What We Learned Deploying AI within Bloomberg’s Engineering Organization – Lei Zhang, Bloomberg
summary: Bloomberg's infrastructure lead on rolling out AI coding to 9,000 engineers: gains fade beyond greenfield work, so they invest in uplift and incident-response agents, a paved path, onboarding training and leadership workshops.

verdicts.note: Single-company observation; no broad independent data on adoption by role level.

At Microsoft, junior-level developers were 4.7pp more likely to adopt Copilot (79.2% vs 74.4%) and short-tenure developers 9.4pp more likely. This matches the direction of the claim, but it compares levels rather than ICs with engineering leaders.
